objective: Find a structurally different, high-capital-velocity Bybit USDT-perpetual alpha before opening any 2024 target interval.

data.provider: Tardis public first-day monthly normalized CSV samples

information_boundary.features: only quotes, top-five snapshots and trades whose local_timestamp is in or before the completed bucket

mechanisms.continuation: opposite-side residual cancellation plus same-side displayed refill, aligned recent aggressive flow and limited already-realized movement
mechanisms.reversal: same-side liquidity pull followed by rapid same-side refill, recent directional recovery and exhaustion of the prior one-second flow

execution.entry: first Bybit quote at or after frozen latency; long crosses ask, short crosses bid
execution.exit: diagnostic fixed markouts only for fatal rejection; a survivor requires a new causal state-exit contract before rank eligibility

promotion.survivor_requirement: state-defined exit, broader pre-2024 replication, complete causal Bybit 2024-2026 account path, funding, risk sizing, marked NAV and latency/liquidity stress
